youtube_title: No Network for Hours? It Could Be a SIM Swap Scam. Scam of the Week #11 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #11. Your phone shows no network since afternoon, even after a restart. A: wait till tomorrow. B: act now, it could be a scam. Comment!
Answer: B. It could be a SIM swap: a fraudster gets a duplicate of your SIM with a fake ID. When the duplicate is activated, your SIM stops working and your bank OTPs go to him. That's why DoT rules bar SMS on a swapped or replaced SIM for 24 hours. If you lose network for long, call your operator right away and ask your bank to block UPI and net banking. If a SIM change confirmation call comes that you never asked for, reject it.
Scammed? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Sources: DoT SIM swap instructions (Nov 2022); Quick Heal advisory.
